author: operator
summary: Answer open planning question and mark plan ready for review.
operator_message: Seed only contract and storage work first; UI follows after backend shape is stable.

questions.question: Which subgoals should be seeded immediately?
questions.answer: Seed plan contracts and storage first.

decisions.title: Compile before execution
decisions.decision: Plans compile into GoalSpec and are not submitted automatically.
decisions.rationale: This preserves human control and keeps Restate authoritative only after goal submission.
